title: Node core surface in one script: fs, http, streams, timers, EventEmitter
intent: The densest fidelity check in the front-end lane. Five core APIs must behave together in one process, which is what an ordinary Node program does before any framework is involved.
source: stackblitz-conformance: NodeJS core (multiple processes, fs operations, http server, streams, timers, EventEmitter) (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Prove the install path runs even with no dependencies to fetch

knownLimits: Each marker is separate so a failure names the API instead of the script. Absence of later markers means execution stopped, which is a liveness finding.
